status.description: scored when the native ordinal distribution was produced; abstained when the model produced none or the runtime marked it low-confidence.

expectedIndex.description: The native probability-weighted 0-based level index (Σ i·p_i), FRACTIONAL and unrounded. It is a mean over the ordinal distribution, not a hard level label; null when abstained.

probabilities.description: The native ordinal distribution in level order: one entry per input level, ids returned unchanged.

probability.description: The model's uncalibrated probability mass for that level (DEC-08).

probabilityKind.description: Names the probabilities as the model's own, uncalibrated probability mass.
